title: Rogersville Chamber of Commerce Christmas Party
seo_title: Rogersville Chamber Christmas Party in Springfield, MO
description: This is the Rogersville Area Chamber of Commerce's annual Christmas party and membership meeting, with a dinner of shrimp scampi, beef medallions, vegetables, potatoes, salad, rolls, mini desserts, water, iced tea and a hot cocoa bar. Tickets are $40 per person and can be booked online, and a cash bar is available for alcohol. It takes place Friday, December 4, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM at the Hilton Garden Inn in Springfield, MO.
address: Tesla, 4155 S Nature Center Way, Springfield, MO 65804-4287, United States, Springfield, MO
